name: 01-split
design: Art direction: SPLIT / decisive typographic kinetic architecture inspired specifically by the card's black-white division. Exact black #000000 and optical white #FFFFFF with vermilion #BC3D2B solely for key controls and a single visual thread; silver #D8DADC neutral. Hero is a bold asymmetric 58/42 split plane, headline gigantic heavy condensed grotesk (Druk-like but highly readable), white on left black field and black on right white field with line breaks deliberately aligned so text never crosses an unreadable seam. Oversized white-black interlocking architectural letterform structure in right hero, abstractly inspired by Ex without creating a new logo. A single red trajectory runs through the structure into a clear bright CTA. Swiss precision but NOT broadsheet newspaper. Lower page uses very large open text, staggered black and white sections, generous margins, varied width horizontal case rows, simple process progressing horizontally. Break the expected grid with one audacious typography moment only, keep rest quiet. Quiz ends as huge white typographic choices inside black floor section. Hyper-polished creative agency design that also looks trustworthy to CFOs. No decorative hairline rule clutter, no all caps labels.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a single exceptional, polished full-page desktop website design screenshot for ExFu, an independent AI consultancy by Alastair Brayne. Portrait 1024x2048 or taller, desktop layout captured as long scroll, NOT a phone layout. One coherent page from navigation to footer, no browser chrome, no devices, no external presentation captions. This is a visionary yet usable website, typography-led, editorial art direction, unexpected composition with calm readable lower content. Professional, warm, plain English. Users are business leaders and CTOs exploring fractional AI help, plus individual professionals. User prioritises visually bold, novel, cutting-edge design demonstrating their own use of agents.
Reference image: the attached BUSINESS CARD IS ONLY A BRAND REFERENCE. Preserve the actual ExFu wordmark: bold white geometric 'Ex' on black, loose red handwritten 'Fu' on white. Integrate a small faithful logo in navigation; do not use card as page background or repeat giant logo unnecessarily.

Navigation: "Work together" "Recent work" "About" "Get in touch"
Hero descriptor: "Fractional AI support & delivery"
Hero headline: "You see the potential. Let’s make it work."
Hero paragraph: "Work out where AI can make a difference in your business. Get the backing to make the case, build it, and bring your team with you."
Primary button: "Find your starting point"
Secondary link: "Have a brief? Let’s talk."
Small availability line: "Remote engagements. Bristol in person by arrangement."

Compact personal route: "Want AI working for you personally?" / "One-to-one setup around your own work." / "Explore personal support"
Short About: "Alastair Brayne" / "20+ years in software. AI founder. Trained psychotherapist."
Final quiz invitation: "What would you like help with?" with three answer options "AI across my business" "A specific project" "My own workload"; button "Find your starting point"; note "A few questions, then an invitation to talk."
Footer "ExFu" "CV & experience" "Open-source tools" "Contact" "ExFu is a trading name of WhaleyBear Ltd."

name: 02-spatial
design: Art direction: CONTEXT IN MOTION / a light spatial website with one spectacular physically rendered sculpture: many broad black and white paper-like ribbons, separated at one end and coherently woven at the other, a red connecting strip passing through. This represents humans, tools and shared context coming together, not a random abstract orb. Hero sits on cool pale blue #E8F0F5, with black #000000 typography, pure white #FFFFFF sections, brilliant cobalt #234BE8 used on a few oversized interaction surfaces and the brand red #BC3D2B only within sculpture and faithful logo. Sculptural object on right roughly 45% width, headline on left in very large elegant rounded humanist sans (Suisse-like), clean regular rather than ultra bold. Museum-quality 3D paper with shadows, beautiful negative space, almost tactile. Sculpture can flow behind ONE section boundary but never obscure text. Lower layout spacious full-width white with generously typeset flowing offer text and asymmetrically paired case studies. One rich cobalt field frames the process with white type. Final quiz large white panel against blue with radio choices as elegant wide lines. This should feel technologically advanced and human, not a SaaS website, not a blue corporate template. No rounded card grid, no fake interface widgets, no computer code.

name: 03-working-canvas
design: Art direction: WORK IN THE OPEN / radically original interactive-workshop aesthetic, vivid red #BC3D2B outer hero field, black #000000 and white #FFFFFF large physical typographic planes, soft cool grey #ECEDEF for lower background. It feels like a strategic thought being made tangible on an expansive graphic workspace, not a generic notes app or sticky-note board. Small faithful logo in a white/black nav strip. Huge black headline upper-left on red with ample white negative plane to right. Hero's right half: a staggered stack of large thin white sheets with black type fragments drawn only from existing process copy ('Find the opportunity', 'Make the case', 'Build and hand over'), one black sheet with a white open circular aperture revealing red below. Restrained dimensional perspective, magnificent modernist poster composition translated into a real navigable site. Use a characterful wide grotesk for heading and readable humanist sans body. Below hero the white page becomes a visible working surface: left broad main fractional offer and right narrowly inset next-step quiz teaser; open stepped process using actual meaningful 1,2,3 if needed; case studies as two large editorial text panels stacked offset with red margin tabs and generous whitespace. No random stickers, handwritten annotations, pencil scribbles, window chrome, all caps labels, dashboards or bento cards. Bottom huge white quiz on black, red answer selection, final footer red. Strong hierarchy and functional simplicity under visually audacious structure.
